LB-010.reason: The receiver stores the final archive chunk and answers extracting; the passive timer (buildRequestedArtifacts) verifies, extracts and writes a completion receipt keyed by key + sha256. A replayed final chunk, or the driver's repeated empty final chunk, answers complete:true from the receipt instead of restarting at offset 0. No 7z extraction runs inside the 120 s peer request, so the push loop is gone. A timer-side mismatch is reported on the next chunk and the driver fails the session, as before.

LB-016.reason: readFileBatch and readFileChunk return a per-file missing marker; the driver skips it (skipResource) in pull batch, pull chunk and push chunk.

LB-017.reason: Passive nodes publish context.resource_roots in the status summary; the driver syncs the intersection and records one-sided roots in resource_results.skipped_roots; an older peer without the field keeps the local roots.

LB-018.reason: Row counts and fresh manifests are timer-built artifacts tagged with a generation (hash of the received counters) and served only when current, 503 busy until then (a TRANSIENT status in the peer client). Export archives are queued in pending_archives and built by the exporter timer.

LB-021.reason: writeFileAtomic adds random bytes to the staging name and deletes it on failure; the six AiGateway stores, AppQyV1DailySentenceService and DeveloperHistoryService now call it instead of their own temp+rename copies.

LB-022.reason: supersede() uses requestCancel plus tryLock on the idle session and throws busy when the lock is held, the same path as a driver cancel.

LB-023.reason: Tables whose identity columns are NOT NULL and selected page by keyset ((ids) > (cursor), identity order, grammar-quoted); next_cursor travels through the driver checkpoint and the exporter GET (validated cursor.*). Other tables and non-scalar identities fall back to OFFSET.
